identity.title: The Archdjinni of the Rings: Hoopa Music Collection

leadText: The Archdjinni of the Rings: Hoopa (Japanese: ポケモン・ザ・ムービーXY「光輪の超魔人フーパ」ミュージックコレクション) is the Japanese soundtrack for the eighteenth movie. It was released in Japan on July 29, 2015.
